note: The corrupted len value is forwarded to the lower-level message-integrity checker with the original input-controlled buffer.
Because len is now a large pointer value, the input-controlled claimed STUN length is accepted even though it exceeds the actual 10-byte candidate size.
The parser derives the first attribute pointer from the claimed STUN message and continues parsing beyond the actual candidate allocation.
stun_attr_get_len reads the attribute length field through attr even though attr is outside this 10-byte candidate, causing an out-of-bounds read.
